Data Planet Ad Market The data planet ad market for Cardano joins the group of data planet apps that interconnect real economy projects with the Cardano community. At the data planet market community members can advertise and sell any product or service for ADA. In this way the data planet market brings Cardano community members together in real life. The fees to advertise are also in ADA, which makes the site totally independent of FIAT currencies. Just pay directly from your wallet. Our goal is to bring members closer together to feel the strength of the Cardano universe not only from bullrun to bullrun, but in real live and independent of the current market valueation of the currency itself.
